name: jlcpcb
label: JLCPCB standard 1-2 layer, 1 oz
notes: Limits of JLCPCB's standard process; JLCPCB also runs its own DFM check on upload.
Holes from 0.15 mm are possible at extra cost; 0.3 mm is the minimum without it.
Copper to edge: JLCPCB lists 0.2 mm for routed edges; 0.3 mm leaves room for the +/-0.2 mm outline tolerance.
Assembly: upload assembly/*-bom-jlc.csv and *-cpl-jlc.csv in the SMT step and check part rotations in JLCPCB's preview.
